history.overview: The Caverns of Exile were once Dragorn exile chambers, later corrupted by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Exile Era
timeline.description: Dragorn exiles were imprisoned in these caverns for severe crimes.

timeline.name: Muramite Invasion
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the caverns but abandoned them due to instability.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord energy warped the caverns, animating spirits and destabilizing stone.

timeline.name: Resistance Recon
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels scouted the caverns but found them too dangerous to occupy.
